shorts_extract.hook: A 7-second memory island, thousands of crossed-out 'NOW I am awake!' diary lines, and unbroken mastery at the piano: the extraordinary neuroscience of Clive Wearing.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Wilson, Baddeley & Kapur (1995 / 2008) 23-year longitudinal study: bilateral hippocampal + temporal-pole encephalitis vs intact basal-ganglia music & limbic love.
shorts_extract.twist: Why real amnesia resets in 20 seconds (not midnight), how Clive's feet learned the way to the kettle over 20 years, and why music unlocks dementia care.
